target_customer: Robotics and embodied AI teams that buy multimodal training data; the YC launch post separately describes AI agent builders who need a browser layer
problem: Robots and embodied agents need synchronized, validated multimodal data (egocentric video, depth, IMU, tactile, hand pose). StableBrowse captures, post-processes and delivers it, including custom data programs.
business_model: Data capture and dataset delivery, including custom programs by skill, environment or sensor stack; pricing not found
product_category: Physical AI data infrastructure (with an earlier browser layer for AI agents)

technical_complexity.rationale: Multimodal capture with synchronization, calibration and validation is real engineering with hardware, but datasets are built from off the shelf sensors by a three person team.

defensibility.rationale: Datasets can build over time, but well funded competitors such as Encord and Ropedia raised far more and the capture methods are replicable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors raised large rounds in early 2026; no acquisition of StableBrowse reported.

market_need_then: Robotics foundation model teams reported a training data bottleneck in 2026, and many data startups raised funding for egocentric and multimodal robot data.

outcome_analysis: StableBrowse is a Spring 2026 company of three former Amazon engineers with no confirmed funding or outcome. Its descriptions swing between a browser layer for agents and robot training data, and in the data market it faces competitors that raised tens of millions in early 2026, so focus and distribution are the main open questions.
